summary: Focused follow-up test: verified page_title_color now applies to Dagsoversigt prev/next day chevron icons (overview-prev-day-button, overview-next-day-button). Set page_title_color to purple (#8E7DBE) via Admin > App-udseende swatch, saved successfully (toast 'Udseende gemt' shown), navigated to Dagsoversigt tab. Screenshot confirms both chevron icons, page title 'Dagsoversigt', date-nav text, dragon name 'Sif', and '(X af Y udført)' progress text all render in the same purple color - consistent with prior tested elements. Functional regression check passed: clicking prev arrow moved date from Torsdag 2. juli 2026 -> Onsdag 1. juli 2026; clicking next arrow twice moved to Fredag 3. juli 2026 (correct day increments, task list content updated accordingly).
critical_code_review_comments: Code change in index.tsx lines 114/120 correctly uses `pageTitleColor || COLORS.textPrimary` for Ionicons color prop on both chevron-back and chevron-forward icons - matches pattern used elsewhere for title/date/progress text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: page_title_color feature (title, date-nav text, dragon name, progress text, and now prev/next day chevrons) is fully verified end-to-end via Admin > App-udseende swatch picker. Automated SVG fill-color extraction via getComputedStyle on Ionicons web SVG returned None (Ionicons on web render differently, likely via a font/svg wrapper not exposing 'fill' on a simple path selector) - visual screenshot comparison was used instead and is a reliable confirmation method for this app's Ionicons rendering on web.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bug found, feature working as expected
